The '''Umbaran jamming field''' was a signal [[Jammer/Legends|jammer]] technology developed by [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]]. The [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Minister of Intelligence]] deployed an Umbaran jamming field inside the [[Blaster's Path]] cantina on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] to be able to safely talk to [[Cipher Nine]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=class|Imperial Agent|Forfeit|Rishi}}</ref>
